name: 23832 · Chesterfield, VA
findings: ZIP 23832 (Chesterfield) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23832 (Chesterfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 10 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
